meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Azure 上规划部署或检查资源限制。
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan deployments or check resource limits on Azure.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以检查和管理 Azure 订阅中的配额（服务限制）和用量，包括查看当前配额、使用量、可用容量，以及请求增加配额。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Azure 配额、服务限制、当前用量、请求增加配额，或计划部署、选择区域、排查配额超限错误时触发。

say.text: 检查我的 Azure 订阅中 East US 区域的 vCPU 配额和使用量。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本返回配额、用量和可用容量。

say.text: 请求将 East US 的 Standard DSv3 配额增加到 500。
say.note: Claude 会提交配额增加请求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can check and manage Azure quotas (service limits) and usage across subscriptions, including viewing current quotas, usage, available capacity, and requesting quota increases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about Azure quotas, service limits, current usage, quota increase requests, or when planning deployments, selecting regions, or troubleshooting quota exceeded errors.

say_en.text: Check my Azure subscription's vCPU quota and usage in East US region.
say_en.note: Claude will run the script to return quota, usage, and available capacity.

say_en.text: Compare Standard DSv3 family VM quotas between East US and West US.
say_en.note: Claude will query across regions and compare available capacity.

say_en.text: Request to increase Standard DSv3 quota in East US to 500.
say_en.note: Claude will submit a quota increase request.
